review.approvalRule: Each required role must record reviewer identity, UTC review time and an HTTPS review record binding approvalPayloadSHA256 emitted by the validator. That digest includes the catalog digest and all tuples, excluding only approval records and status fields. Review records document human approval, not a cryptographic signature.
